<!--
TWO TABLES, NOT ONE, and this is the part worth keeping if the page is
redesigned. A single table with a Week column and one lecture beside one
practical implies the two run in step. They do not: the practical usually starts
several weeks later, may run for alternating cohorts, and often has fewer
sessions than the lecture has topics. Pairing them in one row states a
relationship that is false for most weeks of most courses.

THE FIRST COLUMN IS THE SESSION NUMBER, NOT THE CALENDAR WEEK. They are not the
same -- timetable week 1 frequently carries no lecture -- and calendar weeks both
go stale every year and contradict the timetable.

MAINTENANCE: only link a session once it is in the render allowlist in
_quarto.yml. Linking a held-back session produces a 404, which
scripts/check-links.sh will fail on in CI. Run ./scripts/release.sh status to see
what is currently live.

Titles here mirror COURSE-STRUCTURE.md, which is the design of record and carries
the reasoning. Change that file first.

THIS TABLE GOES STALE SILENTLY, and it did once on a published page: a
renumbering renamed one lecture and swapped two others, the reference sweep that
followed covered the sessions themselves and missed this file, and the live site
showed the old order for three days. WHEN SESSION NUMBERING CHANGES, GREP THE
TITLES HERE TOO.

DELIBERATELY ABSENT: cohort counts, group sizes and dates. Those change every
semester and belong in _course.yml or in the LMS -- see CLAUDE.md, "Things that
rot".
-->
